title: ORC constructed course, version 1
description: One course as ORC Rating Systems rule 402.5 defines a constructed course. See constructed-course-format.md beside this file.

name.description: The course's name, for people. Never matched against anything.

north.description: Every direction in the document is in degrees magnetic: each leg's course, wind direction and current direction.

anchor.description: Where the first leg starts: the position its distance and course are measured from.

legs.description: The legs in sailing order, start to finish. The course length is their sum.

allOf.description: The wind direction is on every leg or on none.
The wind speed is on every leg or on none.

name.description: The leg as the race committee labels it, e.g. "Start – 1".

distance.description: Leg length in nautical miles, to 0.01 NM.

course.description: The leg's direction: the bearing from its start to its end, degrees magnetic.

windDirection.description: The direction the true wind blows from on the leg, degrees magnetic.

windSpeed.description: The true wind speed the race committee recorded on the leg, in knots.

currentDirection.description: The direction the current flows toward (its set), degrees magnetic.
